context: Recovering from a crashing browser, respecting platform limits, formatting tabular output and keeping credentials out of version control.

checklist.name: Cleanup preserves library
checklist.description: The agent recovers from the crash with cleanup_manager.py using --preserve-library, so the notebook library is not wiped.

checklist.name: Cleanup run through wrapper
checklist.description: The cleanup command is invoked as python ./scripts/run.py cleanup_manager.py, not directly.

checklist.name: Markdown output requested
checklist.description: The table query uses ask_question.py with --markdown so the table is returned formatted.

checklist.name: All scripts via wrapper
checklist.description: Every script call, including the query, goes through python ./scripts/run.py.

checklist.name: Daily limit flagged
checklist.description: The agent tells the user that NotebookLM allows 50 queries per day per Google account and that 60 questions would exceed it.

checklist.name: Plan to stay within the limit
checklist.description: The agent proposes prioritising or batching questions, or switching Google account, rather than silently issuing all 60.

checklist.name: Concurrency declined
checklist.description: The agent explains that no concurrent sessions are supported because each query uses a fresh browser instance, and runs queries one after another.

checklist.name: data/ excluded from commit
checklist.description: The agent does not stage or commit the data/ directory, and explains it holds authentication state and library metadata.

checklist.name: Alternative backup offered
checklist.description: The agent offers to commit the rest of the skill folder or suggests another way to back up the library without committing credentials.

checklist.name: Question scoped to the table
checklist.description: The query asks specifically for revenue by region in comparison form, rather than a generic overview of the quarterly reports.
